notes: The prompt self-declares 'Social Deduction / Chaotic Party Survival', and since a declaration naming two genres is a mix, both are recorded: Party & Casual leads because the game is a round-based multiplayer party experience with a vote between rounds, and Survival is second and supplies hazard-kill for the trapdoors and the lava-or-void pit and gate-escape for the escape tasks the round is won by. Shape is rooms-sequence — the author confirmed three themed rooms with the whole server in one room per round before moving to the courtroom, which is a run of discrete enclosed rooms worked through in order, not one open space — and because everyone travels to the vote together there is nobody who must be kept from seeing in, so I did not take space-staged and the build stays on P0. Deciding without a user: social-hub is the courtroom as the between-round gathering space for the full 6-12 server, spectator-zone is where players dropped into the pit wait, and tile-grid is the stated synchronized-tile task. I left spawn-protected off deliberately even though the roles are asymmetric, because separated role spawns would leak who the secret Saboteur is, and the conveyors and giant moving objects have no option row in either loaded file so they ride along as room dressing.
